principle: Synthetic evaluators are high-authority defect finders and low-authority estimators of human-population preference.
release_sequence: create one active RC candidate bound to public product digest
capture release-equivalent evidence before exposing prior verdicts to blind lanes
calibrate each evaluator/model instance on seeded faults before its review can count as PASS evidence
run hostile Goodhart lane with access to machine gates plus rendered evidence
surface all FAIL/veto/contradiction outputs without averaging
if any material alarm exists, reject/supersede the candidate; repair the product or evaluation contract, never the score
only after a clean synthetic defect-discovery pass run release-authoritative machine checks and any required human/field escalation
deploy and repeat live-host smoke/evidence capture; deployment is not proof of perceptual quality

blind_user_lanes: rendered product only plus simple task
specialist_lanes: no other reviewer verdicts before independent observation
hostile_lane: may see gates and prior claims
arbiter_lane: must identify which claim is unsupported and why

aggregation.synthetic_pass: supports defect-discovery closure only; does not establish human preference prevalence

stop_rule: No candidate is terminal while a material counterexample, missing evidence modality, unresolved contradiction, or unreviewed critical criterion remains. Additional synthetic passes stop when new passes no longer discover material defects and the evidence contract is satisfied; human/field questions remain explicitly unclaimed.
